title: Conditions to check for Permanent Deletion

question.author: member_159
question.body: Could support clarify permanent deletion in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Recycle Bin and Deletion documentation says: There is no recovery path for permanently deleted files, including through support. Organization administrators can disable the "Empty recycle bin" button for members via the admin console if accidental mass deletions are a concern. Emptying the recycle bin, or deleting an item from inside the bin, is irreversible. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
